source: CMS Medicare Physician & Other Practitioners - by Provider and Service
shard: npi/<last 3 digits of NPI>.json.gz (gzip of JSON {v, recs:[record,...]})

lineNotes.mod: guessed for PCTC-indicator-1 codes: '' (global), '26' or 'TC'; always '' otherwise
lineNotes.drug: 6th element 1 present only when HCPCS_Drug_Ind = Y; absent otherwise
lineNotes.services: Tot_Srvcs rounded to 1 decimal (integers written without decimals)
lineNotes.sort: services x avgAllowed descending; all lines kept

locality: '<MAC>-<locality>' from the provider's practice ZIP5 via CMS ZIP5_OCT2026 (2026Q4); '' if no match
